name: Signature Shiny

components.effects: She extends her left hand towards the camera, a small glowing fire spell forming in her palm, gradient heat haze shimmering around her; faint flames lick and swirl around her glowing heeled sandals, casting warm light across the ground. A fine prismatic glitter and a gilded, holographic shimmer play across the metal, the fabric and the magic, every glow edged with a rainbow sheen.

notes: SHINY variant of the Signature: same scene and pose in a prismatic, gilded colourway with a holographic glitter sheen. Convention: <slug>-scene-signature-shiny.
